race.comment: Tricky one to close us out. SENSATIONAL SECRET (15) stuck fat to the fence and stretched out nicely late to justify the short quote and shed her tag at Murray Bridge. Drawn less kind this time but has more upside than the rest and with even luck can make it two on the bounce. BOUNCING BEYOND (4) strips rock-hard fit and doesn't know how to run a bad race. Drops back in grade and keeps an important 3kg claim to offset the big weight. Loves this trip and only needs to hold his form to be right there again. JACKS ON ICE (1) struggled in Victoria last time out but his two runs prior in SA were solid. Wet deck is no issue and he can get back on track. DIVERGENT (14) broke her maiden last start and while this is much tougher, you have to respect the stable pitching her into the deep end. Has upside and can't be discounted.
